chapters.title: The Nature of Death and the Afterlife

verses.sanskrit:
गरुडो विष्णुवाहनः पप्रच्छ भगवन्तं हरिम् ।
मृत्युकालेषु जीवानां गतिं वद महाप्रभो ॥
verses.translation: Garuda, the vehicle of Vishnu, asked the Lord Hari: 'O great Lord, please tell me about the fate of beings at the time of death.'

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
धर्मात्मानः सुकृतिनः स्वर्गलोकं व्रजन्ति ते ।
पापिनो नरकं यान्ति कर्मभूमिर्हि मानुषी ॥
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord said: Righteous souls who have done good deeds go to the heavenly realms. Sinners go to the hellish realms. The human world is the field of karma.

verses.sanskrit:
दानं प्रचारः शीलं च मन्त्रो जपस्तथैव च ।
एतानि पञ्च पापानां नाशकानि महान्ति च ॥
verses.translation: Charity, good conduct, virtue, mantra, and japa — these five are the great destroyers of sins.

verses.sanskrit:
श्राद्धं कर्तव्यमनृणतापनिवृत्तये ।
पितॄणां तृप्तिदं नित्यं कर्तव्यं विधिपूर्वकम् ॥
verses.translation: Shraddha (funeral rites) should be performed for the release from ancestral debts. They should always be done according to prescribed rites to satisfy the forefathers.

verses.sanskrit:
गोदानं तिलदानं च स्वर्णदानं जलं तथा ।
अन्नदानं परं दानं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ॥
verses.translation: Donation of cows, sesame seeds, gold, and water — and the supreme donation is food donation, which destroys all sins.
